title: Graphics Test: Sun
desc: The earliest-made program that I could find. Unfortunately, the programs I made in 2014 and earlier were on a separate account which was deleted by Khan Academy for inactivity some time ago.

title: Blightfall (Dev. Only)
desc: I used this project as the "master branch" for working on Blightfall, which was a name that I stole from a Minecraft modpack I liked at the time. This is what I'd spend most of my time working on for the next couple years.

title: Rifted Redesigned (Winston Copy and Paste Code)
desc: You can already see that, this early, I'm already following the pattern of "wanting to start new projects and then giving up immediately" that every programmer is cursed with. I'm pretty sure the title was me telling my friend (nicknamed Winston at the time) to copy and paste the code from this project so he can work on it in his own editor.

title: Period 7
desc: A presentation that I created for my 7th-period typing/computer literacy class for a project where we were teaching the class anything that has to do with computers. There's a bit of println stuff at the end to make the class think I was le epic hackerman

title: Animat3D 2.1
desc: A crude "3d-rendering" library for drawing boxes using 2-point perspective. Edited to animate the boxes to showcase the jank.

title: Gravity Ball
desc: Pong but there's gravity. Click to move the left paddle up. Has some very weird rendering bugs.

title: Get Ready, Get Set, Go! - Gravity Pong Source Code
desc: A surprisingly clean animation. Never actually integrated into "Gravity Pong", though.
